name: The Tarnished
summary: At Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades, the Tarnished threaten a fledgling order's place among the Forsaken. Their attacks deepen mistrust and put the order's future at risk.

sections.title: A Tarnished Order
sections.body: Some risen still bear prejudices from their former lives, and now attack their fellow Forsaken. The Tarnished have gathered at Shadowvale, southwest of here. Their violence must end, and Commander Rudolph Gelhardt’s head must be brought back.

sections.title: A Place Among Them
sections.body: The Tarnished’s attacks give those who distrust the order more reason to turn against it. Stopping them may help the order earn a place among the Forsaken. Acceptance could still take years or decades.

faq.answer: The Tarnished are risen who kept prejudices from their former lives and now attack fellow Forsaken.
A number of the Tarnished have settled at Shadowvale, southwest of here in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why are the Tarnished a threat?
faq.answer: Their attacks on fellow Forsaken deepen mistrust of the order among the Forsaken.
Commander Rudolph Gelhardt leads the Tarnished.

faq.q: Why does the order need the Forsaken's trust?
faq.answer: The order is mistrusted because the Forsaken remember persecution by the living in the name of the Light. The Tarnished’s attacks deepen that mistrust.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you face risen who attack their own people. Their violence worsens mistrust toward a fledgling order.
The order hopes to earn a place among the Horde, but its leader expects acceptance may take years or decades.
